title: DAY 5 — LESSON 1: COMMON CAUSES OF WORKPLACE CONFLICT

options: Any situation where employees have different personalities
A disagreement, tension or dispute that affects workplace relationships or cooperation
Every correction given by a supervisor

questions.prompt: Two employees each assume the other will complete a shared task. What is the likely cause of conflict?
Which behaviour is most likely to escalate a workplace disagreement?
options: Making personal accusations and involving colleagues in taking sides

questions.prompt: What should an employee do after hearing an unverified rumour about a colleague?
options: Share it with the entire team
Avoid spreading it and seek appropriate clarification if necessary
Immediately confront the colleague with an accusation

questions.prompt: What does the ROOT method encourage?
options: Recognising the issue, observing facts, opening respectful communication and taking appropriate action
Reacting immediately, opposing colleagues and transferring blame
